name: antigravity-dev-suite
description: Enterprise Claude Opus 5.5 Coding Standard & Cross-Platform Suite for Antigravity (macOS, Linux, Windows 10/11): Brainstorming, Planning, Strict TDD, Self-Healing Auto-Debug, Adversarial Code Review, Safe Refactoring, and Dual-Viewport Playwright Visual QA.
suggestedPrompts: /opus-dev Esegui lo sviluppo end-to-end con standard Claude Opus 5.5, strict TDD e auto-debug
/brainstorm Analizza i trade-off architetturali e confronta 2-3 approcci alternativi
/plan Scomponi la feature in task atomici sequenziali con target TDD
/auto-debug Esegui e auto-correggi la suite di test in closed-loop
/code-review Esegui un audit avversario a 4 pass (Invarianti, Concurrency, OWASP, Strict Types)
/refactor Riduci il debito tecnico preservando invarianti e test al 100%
/visual-qa Esegui Playwright dual-viewport visual QA (Desktop 1280px + Mobile 375px)
